title: SABER: sequence-informed autoencoder with bilinear decoding for single-cell proteomics

creators.name: Yu, Xiaoran
creators.affiliation: Department of Statistics and Data Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong

description: Implementation, reproduction pipeline, and evaluation tables for the SABER manuscript. SABER reconstructs each protein abundance as a bilinear interaction between a learned cell state and a protein embedding derived from ESM-2, unifying missing-value imputation, representation learning, and zero-shot prediction of held-out proteins in mass-spectrometry single-cell proteomics. The repository ships the collected evaluation tables (figures regenerate without training) plus the full campaign scripts, case-study chains, and external-baseline adapters.
